note: Set A covers more of the page's key facts correctly, including the Region 3 torque-controller saturation, the pitch-to-feather action to hold rated rotor speed, the tip-deflection/tower-clearance design constraint, the force decrease toward the tip, and the sharp linear drop over the outboard 5% from the Prandtl tip-loss model. Set B mislabels TSR = 8.5 as the design point (the design point is TSR = 9.0, 8.5 is the optimum) and attaches an unsupported 'set point tip-speed ratio' condition to the design-point TSR = 9.0 and pitch = 0° claims. Set A's main flaws are one misbinding (calling the ~90 m force peak a 'peak deflection' location) and one claim with a fabricated, misbound quote ('The design point for this pitch Θpitch = 0°'), plus heavy redundancy of the 4° pitch claim. Overall A is more complete and more faithful.
